methods_quotes.q: All estimates of coverage and exemption rates were adjusted based on the type of survey conducted and response rates
Coverage and exemption data based on a reported census were adjusted for nonresponse using the inverse of the response rate, stratified by school type.
data were analyzed as a stratified simple random sample (Delaware, Houston, Virginia, and Puerto Rico).
The median does not include Houston, Guam, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
